prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement `truncate(input, max_bytes, suffix)` in src/lib.rs. If `input` already fits in `max_bytes`, return it unchanged. Otherwise return the longest prefix of `input` that fits in `max_bytes - suffix.len()` bytes without splitting a character, followed by `suffix`. If `suffix` itself is longer than `max_bytes`, return the longest character-safe prefix of `suffix` no longer than `max_bytes`. Never split a UTF-8 character and never panic. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
